This paper proposes a simple yet effective IMT approach, BiTIIMT, which addresses the issues above. The core idea to BiTIIMT is the Bilingual Text-infilling (BiTI) task which extends textinfilling from monolingual setting to bilingual setting and aims to fill missing segments in a revised translation for a given source sentence.
